m1 - INDEPENDENT EXACT-SHA REVIEW: ACCEPT, one non-blocking nit. Full text at msg-01M17AFBAJ8HRA773JQMHZ6MXK.

GATED MYSELF at eaeb3da rather than reading the author's numbers: align JVM 198/198, fixtures JVM 116/116. Matches.

RIGHT: unforgeable carrier (final class, private ctor, non-case - no Mirror, no fromProduct, no copy) with five negative compile probes AND A POSITIVE CONTROL asserting the real doors compile, which is what stops the whole probe set going vacuous on a typo or stale macro. Per-ELEMENT finiteness rather than sum finiteness, so +1 and -1 cannot hide in a zero sum. Guards use explicit isNaN/isInfinite rather than , so they fail CLOSED on NaN - correct polarity under today's rule 7. Three states kept distinct (AllMissing / Undefined(ZeroTotalWeight) / Observed) with a test that asserts coverage.observed 0 versus 1, making the distinction load-bearing. Mass and count carried separately and explicitly not conflated.

NIT, filed rather than demanded: signature.scala now has THREE  methods returning different KINDS of quantity - WeightedCoverage:92 a count fraction, MassRatio:183 a mass fraction, StepMass:248 a count fraction. Each is locally correct and documented. But a consumer reading x.support across carriers gets a count from one and a mass from another with nothing at the call site to say which. Same shape as the two 0.5 thresholds in interview - one word, two quantities, surviving review because each was locally right. Worth a bead; NOT worth widening this candidate's scope.
